title: AC Gravity LLC wins a DoD contract and Li goes silent

tellings.quote: After Li forms her company with Smalley, AC Gravity LLC, they immediately win a DoD contract.

related.note: Both are about the defense money Li and Smalley's company received. This telling says Li then went silent into secret work; Davis says they took the money and delivered nothing.

plain: A researcher named Ning Li, who worked on gravity, is said to have formed a company called AC Gravity LLC with a colleague named Larry Smalley, in Huntsville, Alabama, and then gone quiet after it won a Defense Department contract. Michels tells this himself in an episode about antigravity, the idea of a craft that cancels gravity, saying the two "immediately" won the contract after forming the company. He raises it because a researcher going silent once the military pays her could mean her work became secret.
